The HTML file is not a document that opens an app: it is the app. The code, fonts and charts are all inside it, and nothing is downloaded when you use it.

Setting up: about ten minutes

  1. Extract the ZIP into a folder you will find again. A synced folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) is ideal.
  2. Double-click DebtFreePlan.html. It opens in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox like a web page, and works offline from then on.
  3. Take the welcome tour. A few short slides on adding debts, your plan, logging payments and backups.
  4. Add every debt on My debts, then set your monthly budget when asked.
  5. Download a backup from Settings & backup. Page 9 explains why it matters more than anything else here.

Want to look around first?

Choose Explore sample data on the welcome screen or in Settings & backup. Six fictional debts fill every screen, in a separate session. Return to my debts brings back your own, untouched.

The idea

One date to aim for.

Debt Free Plan answers one question first: when will the last debt reach zero?

Debt freedom. Your debt-free date, total owed, paid so far, and the interest still ahead of you.

WordWhat it means
MinimumWhat each lender requires every month.
ExtraYour monthly budget above all the minimums. It goes to one target debt at a time.
RolloverWhen a debt is cleared, its payment moves to the next one.
Debt-free dateThe month the last debt reaches zero.

Your debts

List every debt once.

My debts → Add a debt. Or import your card and loan downloads (page 6).

What to enterBalance, interest rate (APR), minimum payment and due day. Lender and category are optional; amounts like $5,000 are fine.
Card minimumsChoose Card style for a credit card: 1% of the balance plus that month's interest, never below what you enter. It falls as the balance falls.
0% promosEnter the promo rate and its end month. The standard rate starts on time.
StatusActive and Hardship plan debts are in the plan. Paused, In collections and In dispute stay in your total owed but out of the plan and the debt-free date.
Cards or tableSwitch with Grid and Table. Filter by category; edit categories in Settings.

Your plan

Pick a strategy. Watch it move.

Payoff plan: set your monthly budget and choose how the extra money is aimed.

StrategyHow it works
AvalancheHighest interest rate first. It costs the least.
SnowballSmallest balance first. You see debts disappear sooner.
Cash flowClears the debt that frees the most monthly minimum for its size.
Credit scorePays down the cards closest to their limit first.
Your orderFollows the order you set.

Slide the budget, or tap +$50, +$100, +$250: the debt-free date, interest and every chart follow along.

Paying

Log it. Or import it.

Balances update from the payments you record, and from your statements.

Logging payments

On Debt freedom, Pay this month lists every payment and its due date. Log one, or Log all as paid in one click. Each debt's history icon shows every payment, charge and interest line.

Importing statements

On Import statements, drop the CSV, OFX or QFX files from a card, loan or checking account. Payments, charges and real interest are matched to each debt, and duplicates are skipped.

How interest is worked out

Each month a debt is charged its APR ÷ 12 on the balance, like a card statement. Lenders charge daily, so a statement can differ by a few cents. When a statement arrives, use Update balance; the estimate restarts from there.

Trying ideas

Try it before you do it.

What if and Progress: test a change, then watch the real thing happen.

What ifAn extra payment each month, a one-off payment (a tax refund, a bonus), a lower rate, a balance transfer with its fee, a consolidation loan, or “debt free by” a date you choose. Nothing changes until you apply it.
ProgressThe coloring chart: one bubble for every step paid off. Print it for the fridge. Milestones at 10%, a quarter, half and more.
Due datesEach payment on the day it lands, with what your plan sends.
Find extra moneyAn optional budget and cut-back ideas to grow your monthly payment (switch on in Settings).

Warnings to watch for

A balance that's growing (the payment doesn't cover the interest), a promo rate ending soon, or a card at its limit. They appear on Debt freedom.

Read this one

Keeping your plan safe.

Everything lives in your browser, on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere, there is no account, and nobody else holds a copy, including us.

Your entries live in browser storage: please read

  • Everything you enter or import is saved automatically in that browser's local storage.
  • Clearing your cache, history or site data will permanently delete it.
  • It does not carry across browsers: data added in Chrome will not appear in Safari.
  • The HTML file does not contain your entries. Copying the file does not copy your data.

Do one of these. Ideally both.

Download backup: every browser

Settings & backup → Download backup. One JSON file holding every debt, payment, category and your plan. Restore backup brings it back on any computer. The app reminds you when a backup is due.

Daily folder backup: Chrome or Edge

Choose a synced folder once (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) and a dated copy is written each day you make changes. Safari and Firefox do not offer this; use Download backup instead.

Moving to another computer

Copy the HTML file and your latest backup across, open the file, then Settings & backup → Restore backup.

When you need help

A few useful fixes.

What you seeWhat to do
It opens as code, not an appExtract the ZIP first, then right-click the file → Open with → your browser.
My numbers are goneCheck it is the same browser and profile you used before. Otherwise, Restore backup.
The budget is below the minimumsRaise it to at least the minimums total, or mark a debt Paused if you aren't paying it now.
A balance doesn't match my statementUse Update balance on that debt, or import the statement to bring in the real interest.
“Every line is from before you added…”The file is older than the balance you entered, so those lines are already in it. Import a newer download.
A debt shows as growingThe payment doesn't cover its monthly interest. Raise its payment or your budget.
Folder backup unavailableUse Chrome or Edge on a computer, or Download backup instead.
The currency is wrongSettings & backup → Currency, or type your own symbol. Amounts are not converted.
I want the tour againSettings & backup → Welcome tour → Show tour.
